name: Yellow-shouldered Drone Fly
desc: Yellow-shouldered Drone Fly (Eristalis stipator): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Eristalis stipator, the yellow-shouldered drone fly, is a species of hoverfly native to North America. It is abundant in western North America, with a few scattered records in the east.
